description: This file provides utility functions for managing and querying GPU memory in PyTorch's accelerator context, including cache management, memory statistics, and device info.

methods.name: empty_cache
methods.description: Releases all unoccupied cached memory held by the caching allocator, if initialized.

methods.name: memory_stats
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of memory allocator statistics for a specified device.

methods.name: memory_allocated
methods.description: Returns current device memory occupied by tensors in bytes.

methods.name: max_memory_allocated
methods.description: Returns peak device memory occupied by tensors in bytes since last reset.

methods.name: memory_reserved
methods.description: Returns current device memory managed by the caching allocator in bytes.

methods.name: max_memory_reserved
methods.description: Returns peak device memory managed by the caching allocator since last reset.

methods.name: reset_accumulated_memory_stats
methods.description: Resets the historical memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: reset_peak_memory_stats
methods.description: Resets the peak memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: get_memory_info
methods.description: Returns current free and total memory info for a device in bytes.
